item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud gu ru'i thugs bcud las mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i gsang dbang srog gi 'khor lo
item.coloph: mkha' 'gro 'khros ma'i rgyud las gsang dbang srog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba 'di/ ma 'ongs snyigs dus o rgyan zhing khams su/ yum chen kun sgrol dbang chog zab mo bskur/ ye shes mtsho rgyal lung gis brda rnams bkrol/ snang gsal mdzes spyod man ngag mdor bsdus mdzad/ bdag gis mkha' 'gro'i gnyer gtad thob par byas/ phyi rabs skal ldan grogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ man ngag zab mo yi ge ris su btug nyes mchis mthol bshags stobs 'phrin nus pa yis/ ma 'ongs sangs rgyas bstan pa skyongs du gsol/ ces pa me lug zla tshes bzang po la gnas chen shel le rdzong du bkod pa mu tsug smar ro//
